in_sanskrit.name: अक्सय
in_sanskrit.meaning: अक्षर काल्पनिक, अक्षर के साथ होना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is like an immortal letter or a letter itself. It is a Sanskrit word.

in_hindi.long_meaning: One who is letter-like or associated with letters. It is a Hindi word.

in_tamil.name: அக்சய

in_telugu.name: అక్షయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is like a letter or the one who holds letters. It is a Telugu word.

in_marathi.name: Aksay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aksay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Akshaya’, meaning ‘immortal’, ‘infinite’, and ‘inexhaustible’. In Hindu mythology, the term is also used to represent the god of longevity, Ayurdeva.
